title: Simulation tax model
description: Country tax-estimation rules for trades and securities income. Rules are evaluated from top to bottom and the first matching rule contributes to the estimate.

version.description: Tax model format version. Version 1 is currently supported.

transactionTaxes.description: Taxes charged on BUY and SELL events.

incomeWithholding.description: Withholding deducted from DIVIDEND and SECURITY_INTEREST events.

rule.description: One named tax rule. The first rule whose optional condition is true supplies the country contribution.

name.description: Human-readable rule name shown in estimate details.

condition.description: Optional EvalEx boolean expression. Omit it for an unconditional fallback rule.

expression.description: EvalEx numeric expression returning a finite, nonnegative tax amount in instrument currency.

section.description: A tax section with either undated rules or dated periods, never both.

requiredInputs.description: Optional metadata that must be known before this country's section can contribute.

rules.description: Undated rules evaluated in document order.

periods.description: Non-overlapping date ranges. The event date selects one period before its rules are evaluated.

items.description: An inclusive validity period with its own ordered rules.

validFrom.description: First event date covered by the period, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

validTo.description: Last event date covered by the period, inclusive, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Omit for an open-ended period.

rules.description: Rules evaluated in document order for this period.
